facts.text: Deborah canceled a yoga getaway due to a storm.

evidence.quote: Hey Jolene, had a tough week. Storm forced us to cancel our yoga getaway.

facts.text: Deborah found comfort in her work and time at home after the cancellation.

evidence.quote: I was bummed about it, but I'm doing better now. It was just a setback, but I found comfort in my work and spending time at home.

facts.text: Jolene plans a camping trip with her partner to practice yoga and connect with nature.

evidence.quote: My partner and I plan a camping trip to connect with nature and practice yoga.
